performance.interpretation: No demonstrated whole-workload speedup from limiting CAM active generate to1; not a production recommendation. Three separate job samples overlap in range and are not a significance test.

limitations: All8 CAM weights remain loaded and all8 are actually used; this is an active-generate concurrency probe, not a single-model-memory/replica experiment.

The outer lock includes original runner context, feature extraction, forward/readback, original synchronization and base observation capture. It changes scheduling of the entire CAM call; it does not isolate GIL, FP32 guard, feature extraction, host enqueue or NPU arithmetic separately.
Emo8 and the single Qwen child remain concurrent; same NPU7 shared contention and external process conditions still apply.

Serial calling-thread CPU sums are ~9s vs prior parallel~17s, but calling-thread CPU excludes intraop workers and cannot be used as total host CPU or kernel time. Reduced calling CPU did not produce an elapsed benefit here.
Sum of queued outer-lock waits overlaps across8 model leases and must never be added to wall time.
Vector agreement uses original CAM192/emo7 outputs+exact labels at atol=rtol1e-5; Qwen raw/parsed exact. No transcript truth or accuracy score.
Fixed128 scope excludes full4369 dynamic arrivals/backpressure; this result does not settle full-audio B8 scheduling throughput.

owned_drain.change_scope: Only test-owned HTTP request graceful drain; main/core/config business timeouts, 420-second watchdog, outer resource cleanup and port observation remain separate.
